reviewHot.sql: SELECT accommodation_id,total_review_count FROM accommodation_review_summary ORDER BY total_review_count DESC LIMIT 3

reviewTypical.sql: SELECT accommodation_id,total_review_count FROM accommodation_review_summary WHERE total_review_count BETWEEN 5 AND 10 ORDER BY accommodation_id LIMIT 1

wishlistHot.sql: SELECT id,member_id,accommodation_count FROM wishlist WHERE status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY accommodation_count DESC,id LIMIT 3

wishlistTypical.sql: SELECT id,member_id,accommodation_count FROM wishlist WHERE status='ACTIVE' AND accommodation_count=5 ORDER BY id LIMIT 1

hostHot.sql: SELECT member_id,COUNT(*) n FROM accommodation GROUP BY member_id ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 3

couponOwnerHot.sql: SELECT member_id,COUNT(*) n FROM member_coupon GROUP BY member_id ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 3

statsLast.sql: SELECT stat_date FROM daily_revenue_stats ORDER BY stat_date DESC LIMIT 1

settlementLast.sql: SELECT settlement_month FROM settlement ORDER BY settlement_month DESC LIMIT 1

couponReadiness.sql: SELECT issue_strategy,COUNT(*),SUM(stock_prepared_at IS NOT NULL),MIN(issue_start_at),MAX(issue_end_at) FROM coupon GROUP BY issue_strategy
